note: Written and committed BEFORE any validation number was run. Do not edit after the first run without issuing a new revision and saying why.
rule: A published comparison tolerance is 2 x the half-unit of the last printed digit of the published value, rounded up to a clean figure, then widened only where the source gives a reason. A solver-to-solver tolerance is set by the stated convergence tolerance of both solvers.

solver_settings.pandapower: pp.runpp(net, algorithm='nr', init='flat', tolerance_mva=1e-9, max_iteration=50, enforce_q_lims=False, calculate_voltage_angles=True)
solver_settings.independent: polar Newton-Raphson in numpy, mismatch tolerance 1e-10 per unit on a 100 MVA base, generator reactive limits not enforced

checks.basis: published to 2 decimals, half-unit 0.005, widened to 0.05 because the 1962 data were solved with a 1990s-era program whose convergence tolerance is not stated: NOT SOURCED

checks.quantity: total active loss, sum of Pg minus sum of Pd
checks.basis: difference of two published 1 decimal sums

The harness reads inputs/LV12/case9_published.csv if Jack supplies it; tolerances then Vm 0.001 pu, Va 0.05 degree, set by the same rule as C14.
